unit_cn: Unit 2 Healthy Lifestyle 健康生活
source: 人教版2019选择性必修三 Unit 2 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、健康生活主题(戒坏习惯/压力管理/健康饮食/运动/心理健康)、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.meaning_cn: 吸引(注意力);吸收;理解吸收
words.example_en: He got so absorbed in the game that he forgot to sleep.
words.example_cn: 他玩游戏太入迷,以至于忘了睡觉。

words.example_en: Alcohol abuse can damage both the body and the mind.
words.example_cn: 酗酒会损害身体和心理。

words.example_en: Many young people decide to give up alcohol for a healthier life.
words.example_cn: 许多年轻人决定戒酒以获得更健康的生活。

words.example_en: To avoid cigarette smoke is the first step to protect your lungs.
words.example_cn: 远离香烟烟雾是保护肺部的第一步。

words.example_en: When I feel stressed out, I like to watch a comedy to relax.
words.example_cn: 当我感到压力大时,我喜欢看喜剧来放松。

words.example_en: A healthy lifestyle is composed of good food, exercise and enough sleep.
words.example_cn: 健康的生活方式由健康饮食、运动和充足睡眠组成。

words.example_en: It is useful to turn to a fitness consultant for advice.
words.example_cn: 向健身顾问求助是很有用的。

words.example_en: Feeling unhappy can act as a cue to eat unhealthy snacks.
words.example_cn: 不开心可以成为吃不健康零食的信号。

words.example_en: There is no delete button that can simply remove a bad habit.
words.example_cn: 没有哪个删除键能轻易删掉一个坏习惯。

words.example_en: The dentist told me that too much sugar had damaged my teeth.
words.example_cn: 牙医告诉我太多糖已经损害了我的牙齿。

words.example_en: To change a bad habit, a person must show some discipline.
words.example_cn: 要改掉坏习惯,一个人必须表现出一些自制力。

words.example_en: It is not polite to disturb your neighbours with loud music at night.
words.example_cn: 夜里用很大声的音乐打扰邻居是不礼貌的。

words.example_en: Skipping breakfast often makes me feel dizzy in class.
words.example_cn: 经常不吃早餐让我在课上感到头晕。

words.example_en: It is essential to stop bad habits from dominating a teenager's life.
words.example_cn: 阻止坏习惯支配青少年的生活是至关重要的。

words.example_en: To take drugs is both illegal and dangerous to your health.
words.example_cn: 吸毒既违法又危害你的健康。

words.meaning_cn: 充满活力的;精力充沛的;动态的
words.example_en: After exercising regularly, she felt more dynamic and stronger than ever.
words.example_cn: 坚持运动后,她感到比以往更有活力、更强壮。

words.example_en: Rock climbing has enhanced the quality of my life.
words.example_cn: 攀岩提高了我的生活质量。

words.example_en: Instead of taking the escalator, you could take the stairs for exercise.
words.example_cn: 你可以走楼梯锻炼,而不是坐自动扶梯。

words.example_en: We must first examine our bad habit cycles before we can change them.
words.example_cn: 我们必须先检视自己的坏习惯循环,然后才能改变它们。

words.example_en: To facilitate a positive change, we should replace a bad routine with a good one.
words.example_cn: 为促成积极的改变,我们应当用好的常规取代坏的常规。

words.example_en: Because of his poor diet, he got the flu very easily.
words.example_cn: 由于饮食不佳,他很容易得流感。

words.example_en: Breaking a bad habit gave him a real sense of liberation.
words.example_cn: 戒掉一个坏习惯让他有一种真正的解脱感。

words.meaning_cn: 每月(的);每月一次(的);月刊
words.example_en: Now my dad and I go rock climbing together monthly.
words.example_cn: 现在我和爸爸每月一起去攀岩。

words.example_en: We could try to replace a negative routine with something more positive.
words.example_cn: 我们可以试着用更积极的事情取代消极的常规。

words.example_en: Instead of sweets, she brought fruit and nuts as healthy snacks.
words.example_cn: 她没带糖果,而是带了水果和坚果作为健康零食。

words.example_en: If we fail at first, we often become pessimistic and give up.
words.example_cn: 如果一开始就失败,我们常常变得悲观而放弃。

words.meaning_cn: 身体的;客观存在的;物理学的
words.example_en: Bad habits can lead to physical and mental health problems.
words.example_cn: 坏习惯会导致身体和心理健康问题。

words.example_en: There is no magic pill that will change your bad habits for you.
words.example_cn: 没有什么神奇药丸能替你改掉坏习惯。

words.example_en: According to modern psychology, we must understand the habit cycle.
words.example_cn: 根据现代心理学,我们必须理解习惯循环。

words.meaning_cn: 使恢复精力;使凉爽;刷新
words.example_en: I get refreshed through climbing and feel much more energetic.
words.example_cn: 我通过攀岩恢复精力,感觉精神多了。

words.example_en: The bad habit of relying on unhealthy snacks is easily formed.
words.example_cn: 依赖不健康零食的坏习惯很容易养成。

words.example_en: We are what we repeatedly do, so small steps matter.
words.example_cn: 我们就是我们反复做的事,所以小步骤很重要。

words.meaning_cn: 回报;奖励;报酬;给以报酬
words.example_en: The reward is the good feeling we get from a routine.
words.example_cn: 回报是我们从某个常规中得到的好感觉。

words.example_en: It is required for the new soldiers to shave off their beards.
words.example_cn: 新兵被要求剃掉胡须。

words.example_en: Sometimes he jumped on his skateboard and rode around the neighbourhood.
words.example_cn: 有时他跳上滑板,在小区里到处滑行。

words.example_en: It is harmful to skip breakfast often.
words.example_cn: 经常不吃早餐是有害的。

words.example_en: I persuaded my father to see a lung specialist.
words.example_cn: 我说服父亲去看肺科专家。

words.example_en: Do something that stimulates your mind and makes you feel happy.
words.example_cn: 做一些能激发你头脑、让你开心的事。

words.example_en: She stopped buying all the sweets and sugary drinks.
words.example_cn: 她不再买所有的糖果和含糖饮料。

words.example_en: It took the surgeon three hours to finish my mother's lung surgery.
words.example_cn: 那位外科医生花了三个小时完成我母亲的肺部手术。

words.example_en: If he keeps smoking, he may need surgery in the future.
words.example_cn: 如果他继续抽烟,将来可能需要做手术。

words.example_en: The nicotine in tobacco can do great damage to your lungs.
words.example_cn: 烟草中的尼古丁会严重损害你的肺。

words.meaning_cn: 有规律地;定期地;经常地
words.example_en: To exercise regularly keeps us fit and healthy.
words.example_cn: 有规律地锻炼能使我们保持健康。

words.example_en: To give up smoking takes a lot of willpower.
words.example_cn: 戒烟需要很大的意志力。
